title: Warped Forest Field
summary: A twisted Nether forest that mixes Forest, Dimensional, Wasteland and a little Volcanic. Weather cannot survive here and nothing freezes.

sections.heading: Type power
lines: Grass, Dark and special Bug moves are 1.5× stronger. Ghost moves are 1.2× stronger.
Fire moves are 1.3× stronger. Water moves are 0.8× and Ice and Fairy moves are 0.5×.
Mimicry, Camouflage and Terrain Pulse use the Dark type. Nature Power becomes Wood Hammer. Secret Power can flinch.

Move-specific boosts multiply with the type boost: Power Whip and Vine Whip are 1.5× on top of the Grass bonus (2.25× in total); Dark Pulse and Night Daze are 1.2× on top of the Dark bonus (1.8×) and never miss.
Hyperspace Fury, Hyperspace Hole, Shadow Force and Spacial Rend are 1.5× stronger.

sections.heading: Warped flora
lines: Damaging Grass moves also count as Dark when working out type effectiveness. This includes Slash, Air Slash, Fury Cutter, Air Cutter, Psycho Cut, Breaking Swipe and Cut, which gain the Grass type here as in the Forest.
The extra type changes damage only; it never adds same-type bonus.
Leech Seed drains 1/4 of maximum HP each turn instead of 1/8.

sections.heading: Dimensional distortion
lines: Gravity, Magic Room, Trick Room and Wonder Room last a random 3 to 8 turns.

sections.heading: Weather and status
lines: Weather cannot be started here, and weather already in effect disappears when the field begins.

sections.heading: Abilities
lines: Grass Pelt, Leaf Guard, Overgrow and Swarm are active as in the Forest.
Effect Spore triggers 60% of the time. Sap Sipper restores 1/16 of HP each turn.
Rattled raises Speed by 1 and Unnerve lowers the opposing Pokémon's Speed by 1 when they enter.
Poison Heal and Toxic Boost work for grounded Pokémon.

sections.heading: Seed and Shelter
lines: Magical Seed: Defense +1, Special Defense +1, Speed −1, and the holder takes root (Ingrain).
Shelter halves Dark damage to its user.
